data.name: Historiker
data.detailed_description:
A station you were never told about

An envelope, a set of keys, and the deed to a railway station no one in your family ever spoke of. You go to see what you have been left — and find that its platforms do not lead where platforms lead.

Four cities, a century apart

Each platform opens onto a real place at a real time: Berlin, Paris, New York, Hong Kong, decades apart. You are not shown a museum of them. You walk their streets, read their signs, speak to the people standing on their corners, and pick up what they left lying around.

A clue in one era changes another

This is the whole game. Something you read in one city means nothing until a thing you find in another tells you what it was. The notebook you carry between them is the only place those two halves ever meet — and the story is what you assemble in it, not what you are told.

Quiet, first-person, unhurried

No combat, no timers, no fail state. Historiker is about looking closely and following a thread across a hundred years, at your own pace.

A preview is in development. Wishlist to hear when it opens.

data.short_description: You have inherited a train station from a family that never mentioned it. Walk its platforms into Berlin, Paris, New York and Hong Kong across the last century, and learn how a single clue found in one decade rewrites the meaning of another.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU with 2 GB VRAM (e.g. NVIDIA GTX 1060)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1 or later) or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU with 2 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
